documents.doc-cz-msz-pha-2026-09-01-3-kzn-974-2026: The Prague Municipal Public Prosecutor's Office re-examined the relevant part of Dušan Dvořák's filing of 27 May 2026 and follow-up filings of 14, 15 and 19 July 2026 after the Brno Municipal Public Prosecutor's Office returned the transferred part under reference 3 ZN 140/2026-3. The Prague office concluded that the filings, insofar as they concerned persons serving or formerly serving at the Supreme Public Prosecutor's Office, did not contain concrete facts reasonably indicating an offence under Sections 329, 330 or another provision of the Criminal Code. It therefore filed the submissions without further action under Section 16a of the Public Prosecutor's Office Act and treated them as disposed of. The notice expressly states that the manner of disposal may be submitted for review under Section 16a(7) to the Prague High Public Prosecutor's Office.
